Fill in three placeholders (who you are, your vision, your budget + date), run the bootstrap prompt, and a planner agent builds your vendor matrix, budget tracker, 18-month timeline, guest-list scaffold, vow + speech generators, RSVP system, and a day-of runbook. One agent, two routines, complete sanity in the chaos.

1214

Music Factory

v0.2.0

A browser-native MIDI factory. Pick a famous public-domain song, watch the piano roll, listen via Web Audio synthesis, download a real .mid file. Ships with Ode to Joy, Für Elise, Twinkle Twinkle, Jingle Bells, Happy Birthday, Tetris (Korobeiniki), Canon in D, and When the Saints Go Marching In — plus the original Portal "Still Alive" player as a sub-app.
